caption: The drawing shows a front view of a double wooden door with six rectangular panels on each side, rendered in shades of blue and turquoise with visible wood grain texture. The doors are joined in the center and feature three metal hinges and a latch mechanism, all depicted in brown. Above the door, the words "Door Front" are written, with a scale bar below. Flanking the doors on the left and right are labeled black-and-white sectional profiles of architectural moldings, titled “Capital” on the left and “Base” on the right. Directly beneath the door, a detailed sectional profile labeled “Meeting Stile” is at the center, with a “Pilaster” profile below it and another scale bar marked "1ft." The lower right corner of the page is signed with the name “Geoffrey Holt.” The drawing is on an off-white background.
title: Doors (Inside View)
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
